pages.text: Create: Hangars scatters small aircraft sheds across the Overworld. Their chests hold starter Aeronautics parts, so a first ship does not have to start from scratch.
Hangars come in eight biome styles: plains, birch, taiga, dark oak, cherry, jungle, bamboo and savanna. Jungle and plains versions are the most common. They are spaced roughly 500 blocks apart.
pages.title: Where

pages.text: Shelf chests hold Hot Air Burners, Hot Air Envelopes, Propellers, Windmill Sails, Symmetric Sails, Springs, Redstone Magnets and basic Create gear. Pulley chests hold Rope Couplings and Andesite Casing.
pages.title: Loot
Hot Air Burner
pages.text: A common find on hangar shelves, along with envelopes and propellers.

pages.title: Rope Coupling
pages.text: Found in pulley chests. Links a Rope Winch to a Rope Connector.

pages.text: Airships, other places to fly and world structures.
